_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the ATV 2 free-roam hub (atvrecomp web/tools/roamhub.mjs). Our own code only: the hub relays player names, rider choices and poses between players and holds nothing from the game.
name: ATV 2 Free Roam Hub
author: admin@atvqpr2.com
description: WebSocket hub for ATV Quad Power Racing 2 free roam (Free Ride, Stadium). Players connect through https://atvqpr2.com via wss://hub.atvqpr2.com (Cloudflare proxy). Single Node.js file, no npm packages, no game data.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ATV 2 free-roam hub: nothing to install (one Node.js file, built-in modules only).
# Upload atv2-roamhub.zip into the server's root with the panel's File Manager (or SFTP) and Unarchive it:
# it holds web/tools/roamhub.mjs and web/roamhub-worker/protocol.mjs.
# Nothing is downloaded here, and nothing from the game is ever needed.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f web/tools/roamhub.mjs ]; then
  echo 'Upload atv2-roamhub.zip here (File Manager or SFTP), Unarchive it, then start the server.' > UPLOAD-atv2-roamhub.txt
fi
echo 'install done'

variables.name: Allowed origins
variables.description: Comma-separated web origins whose pages may connect (the browser's Origin header). Others are refused.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Players connected at once, all rooms together.

variables.name: Max rooms
variables.description: Rooms (sessions) at once. Each room holds up to 8 riders (the game's limit).

variables.name: Max connections per IP
variables.description: Connections from one address at once (read from Cloudflare's CF-Connecting-IP header).

variables.name: Idle timeout (seconds)
variables.description: A connection that sends nothing for this long is closed.

variables.name: Allow the Windows game (no Origin header)
variables.description: 1 lets the native Windows build connect (it sends no Origin header); 0 allows browsers from the allowed origins only.
